How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
Our normal order processing time is 2 business days from the date of your order, excluding weekends and holidays.
Once your order ships, you will receive a confirmation email with your tracking number, which typically becomes active within 24 hours.
If you would like us to look into your order status directly, please feel free to share your order number and email address!

Is there any way to speed it up if I need it sooner?
Once an order has been placed, we are unable to change the shipping method or modify the order details.
If you need an item faster for future orders, we do offer Expedited Shipping (1 to 3 business days) at checkout for an additional fee.
If you'd like us to check on your current order's status, feel free to share your order number and email address!
